title: Cowork Cookbook Recipe
description: Schema for a single recipe.yaml file. See README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md for context.

id.description: Kebab-case slug. Permanent; renames must add an entry to taxonomy/redirects.yaml.

business_value.description: Why this recipe matters to the business — outcomes, time saved, risk reduced, decisions enabled. Plain prose, one or two sentences.

plugin.description: The Cowork plugin a recipe depends on. 'none' means the recipe runs on built-in Cowork skills alone - it may still ship an installable custom skill of its own, recorded in uses_skills.custom.

blueprint.description: A workflow diagram the user pastes into Cowork alongside the prompt. The diagram carries the SHAPE of the process; prompt.md binds every input to a concrete VALUE so the agent needs no clarifying turns.

mermaid.description: Mermaid source filename in the recipe folder. Canonical artifact; the image is derived from it.

image.description: Rendered diagram filename in the recipe folder. This is the file the user pastes into Cowork.

source_node.description: Taxonomy node id the blueprint was generated from, e.g. record-to-report/close-financial-periods.

inputs.description: Every variable the diagram references. Each must be bound by prompt.md — an unbound input is what makes Cowork ask a clarifying question.

clarifying_questions_asked.description: How many questions Cowork asked before executing, measured during verification. 0 is the quality bar.

mutates_data.description: True if the recipe creates or modifies data in the target system (e.g., D365). Requires VERIFICATION.md.

reviewed_by.description: GitHub handle of the human reviewer. Required, but for draft recipes this just records the maintainer who curated the metadata — it does NOT imply functional verification.

status.description: draft = metadata only, prompt has NOT been run against a live Cowork tenant. verified = a human has actually executed the prompt and confirmed the recipe works, and last_verified_on / verified_against_cowork_build are populated.

last_verified_on.description: Required when status=verified. Omit for drafts.

verified_against_cowork_build.description: Required when status=verified. Omit for drafts.
